senses.gloss: m. (מָרַר) embittering, hard labor (with ref. to Ex. I, 14).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3">Num. R. s. 3</cite> the family was called M’rari, <he>על</he> (<cite ref="U01406"><he>שם</he></cite>) <he>מ׳</he> an allusion to their bitter task (of carrying the wooden material of the Tabernacle).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>מרים</he> … <he>לשון מ׳</he> Miriam intimates the bitterness (of slavery); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 986">Yalk. Cant. 986</cite>. [<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:11:1">Cant. R. to II, 11</cite>, a gloss.]
